lemmas.name: B36_object_readable

lemmas.name: B36b_object_not_continuation

lemmas.why: Continuation is an estimate, not a finished leftover list. B35b already missed that slogan.

lemmas.name: B36c_object_not_ns

lemmas.why: Naming the object is not sitting the packet. Do not promote a desk sentence to a type.

lemmas.name: B36d_object_not_integral_max
lemmas.statement: the leftover catalog is an integral bound on the max vorticity
lemmas.why: A leftover list is not ∫‖ω‖_∞. Beale still asks for the max.

lemmas.name: B36e_object_not_regularity
lemmas.statement: this leftover close decides classical regularity
lemmas.why: No. Domain B stays open. The leftover is X. Do not spawn n=64. Do not type c=8 into the PDE.

lemmas.name: B36f_not_a_pde_retune
lemmas.statement: scoring leftover knobs as not deciding regularity is a retune of classical Navier–Stokes
lemmas.why: The PDE is untouched. Leftover knobs are knobs on the check. No Q1. No ε. Do not type c=8 into the equation. Do not spawn n=64.
